courts.name: Amtsgericht Mitte
courts.covers: Mitte, Moabit, Hansaviertel, Tiergarten and Prenzlauer Berg
courts.note: Prenzlauer Berg sits in Bezirk Pankow but signs here.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Wedding
courts.covers: Wedding, Gesundbrunnen and the whole of Reinickendorf
courts.note: Wedding and Gesundbrunnen are Bezirk Mitte on paper, not here.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Pankow
courts.covers: Bezirk Pankow apart from Prenzlauer Berg
courts.note: The building is in Weißensee, not in Pankow proper.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Kreuzberg
courts.covers: Friedrichshain, Kreuzberg, Tempelhof, Mariendorf, Marienfelde and Lichtenrade
courts.note: The whole old Bezirk Tempelhof comes here, not to Schöneberg.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Schöneberg
courts.covers: All of Steglitz-Zehlendorf plus Schöneberg and Friedenau
courts.note: Two halves of Tempelhof-Schöneberg go to two different courts.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg
courts.note: One Bezirk, one court, no surprises.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Neukölln
courts.note: One Bezirk, one court, no surprises.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Spandau
courts.note: One Bezirk, one court, no surprises.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Lichtenberg
courts.note: Marzahn-Hellersdorf has no court of its own.

courts.name: Amtsgericht Köpenick
courts.note: The longest ride in the city for Altglienicke and Schmöckwitz.
